text:
zoe: quick sync 1 re: new left-rail grouping proposal. thinking of 3 top clusters: Projects, Models, Platform. primary goals: fewer clicks, predictable deep links, and clearer breadcrumbs in compact mode. initial reactions?
mateo: Sounds good. One think: when a permalink points to a nested item (eg /ws/7/models/model-37/versions), the sidebar must highlight the exact leaf and its cluster. Otherwise users get lost.
li: Accessibility nit: collapsible cluster headers must be <button aria-expanded> and the list should be a real list (role=list) so screen readers announce item counts. Also add a visible "Skip to main" as the first focusable element.
rachel: Copy bikeshed: "Projects" vs "Apps" vs "Workloads". For cross-team clarity I prefer "Projects". Also microcopy under a missing-deeplink fallback: "We couldn't find that item in this workspace 1 showing Models hub." with an action "Open original workspace".
zoe: Agree on fallback banner (non-modal). Behavior: if permalink references an id that doesn't exist in current workspace, show banner + keep user on cluster hub. Offer action to attempt workspace switch. Keep focus where it is; don't auto-switch.
mateo: Dev note: routing plan: canonical URL format proposal -> /workspace/:ws/cluster:models/item/:id (explicit cluster slug). Add thin compatibility resolver for legacy paths (/ws/:ws/models/:id -> redirect).
li: A11y detail: if we show a cluster chip left of the breadcrumb for compact rail, make the chip aria-hidden and ensure the breadcrumb nav still contains the cluster as a real crumb for assistive tech.
rachel: Also suggest a small UX tweak: when the rail is icon-only, hover-expansion is fine for mouse, but provide a keyboard toggle (Settings > Navigation: Compact / Expanded) so keyboard users aren't forced into hover.
accessibility-bot: [audit] collapsed-cluster-roles: missing aria-controls on 2 items; skip-link not present in prototype. See https://ci.redwood/a11y/678
zoe: Thanks bot. Action items: Mateo -> implement highlight precedence: leaf > section > cluster + add unit tests. Li -> ARIA audit & add missing attributes. Rachel -> draft banner copy + run a quick in-console poll for Projects vs Apps. I'll book a 20-min touch tomorrow 10:00 PT to review.
mateo: Adding tests now. I'll also add telemetry when fallback occurs so we can measure how often permalinks fail to resolve.
li: Will run audit and attach keyboard-only recordings.
rachel: Poll going live in #research. Draft copy options: Option A: "Projects" (product-friendly). Option B: "Apps & Jobs" (explicit for infra users).
zoe: Great. Sync invite sent. :calendar:
mateo: small unit-test note: ensure when landing on /workspace/42/cluster:projects/pipeline/9 we highlight Projects > pipeline > 9 and breadcrumb shows same order.
li: also ensure breadcrumb has aria-label="Breadcrumb" and the current leaf has aria-current="page".
rachel: I'll prepare Figma mockups for chip vs full-cluster-crumb so we can A/B test the visual approach.
accessibility-bot: [reminder] follow-up audit scheduled 2524683600
